notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T145155Z. The BLS PPI, CPI and average-price series carry September 2026. Prose drafted 2026-10-25 by a session from numbers.md at the editor's instruction, then revised on an independent review that recalculated every headline figure from the captured reports (all matched) and required five changes and eleven clarifications; the editor read and signed the result. tools/check.py passes at 189 figures. This is the first issue of this title; its September 2026 baseline does not publish (owner decision 2026-10-25). The issue is published on the 2026-10-18 run although a later weekly capture (2026-10-23T220814Z) holds the week ending 2026-10-16: the editor kept the run the computed set and the review rest on. Gaps in this month's figures: the NASS Quarterly Hogs and Pigs source was recorded PARTIAL. All four rolling Todays_Reports candidates returned HTTP 404 and the quarterly reading was recovered from the ESMIS archive copy, hgpg0926.txt, the September 2026 release, by the archive fallback PROVENANCE.md describes. The reading is present and complete. Known limits of this issue. The pork cutout and primal figures are for the week ending 2026-10-09, published 2026-10-12, because report 2680 normally publishes on Monday for the prior week; the beef cutout and CME cheddar series reach the week ending 2026-10-16, so this title reads one week behind them. The pork cutout is comprehensive (all sales types and delivery periods); the beef cutout is negotiated sales delivered within 0-21 days. The cutout and primals are estimated values per 100 pounds FOB plant on a 215-pound barrow and gilt carcass, not the price of any cut, and the issue says so. The September PPIs are preliminary. The hogs and pigs figures carry no two-year comparison. The USDA ERS attributes are August to August, from the update of 2026-09-25. Month-to-month movement is not in this issue's computed set. The weekly pork variety meat report is retained and not parsed, so it contributes no figure. The verification gate reads no bare count or worded quantity in prose: the product specifications quoted from report 2680, the counts of primals and fetch candidates, the worded groupings of primal changes, and the weekly paths quoted were checked by hand against the retained captures and the computed set.
